title: enhance unified rollouts: canary + A/B + shadow autorollback workflow and observability
author: Priya Sharma
description:
Motivation: customers running mixed workloads (hosted + dedicated) reported flaky canary rollouts where transient latency regressions or model hallucination spikes caused manual rollbacks. This PR improves the unified rollouts controller to (1) expand metric matching for A/B and canary stages, (2) add shadow probing windows and quarantine stage, and (3) tighten observability and safety guards to reduce false-positive auto-rollbacks.

Summary of changes: - Add conditional weighted canary step for A/B experiments with deterministic weight adjustments. - Implement probing stage for shadow traffic with a quarantine path: if probing metrics breach thresholds, traffic to new variant is paused and quarantined for manual review. - Extend autorollback engine to support multi-metric composite rules (latency P95, error-rate, and custom quality regression signal) and metric quorum logic to avoid noisy single-metric failures. - Enhanced telemetry: new rollout_span tracing, per-rollout metric snapshots to S3, and rollout-level dashboards. - Add e2e and integration tests for staged-shadow probing and auto-rollback logic.

Checklist:
- [x] Design doc (Linear: ENG-1289) and working prototype
- [x] Unit tests for rollout decision engine
- [x] Integration tests for staged shadow + quarantine path
- [x] Observability dashboards and alert rules
- [x] Backwards compatible configuration (old rollout specs still work)
- [x] Performance microbench to verify controller latency impact

Backward compatibility: rollout spec remains compatible; new fields (probing_window_ms, quarantine_policy, composite_metrics) are optional. Existing deployments default to previous behavior.

Rollout plan: merged to main behind a feature flag rollout.unified_rollouts_v2; gradual enablement to 5% of orgs, monitor for 48h, then increase. Manual rollback path preserved.

Related: Linear ENG-1289 (design), ENG-1345 (observability), related PRs pr-318002/pr-331213 for earlier autorollback prototypes.

Full description (single string): This PR modernizes the autorollback and rollout orchestration to reduce noise and improve safety for canary, A/B, and shadow workflows. It adds a probing stage that uses shadow traffic to validate quality signals before shifting user-visible traffic, a quarantine mechanism to hold suspect variants for manual inspection, and composite metric logic to require multiple signals to agree before triggering auto-rollback. Observability additions make it easier to diagnose rollouts after the fact.

release_notes:
- Added probing stage for shadow traffic to validate model quality before exposing variants to user traffic.
- Quarantine policy to hold variants that fail probing for manual review.
- Composite metric autorollback with quorum logic to reduce noisy rollbacks.
- Enhanced rollout tracing and metric snapshots for postmortem and dashboards.
- New e2e and integration tests for staged shadow and autorollback workflows.
tests: Unit: autorollback engine coverage + added quorum edge tests. Integration: staged-shadow probing and quarantine path (ci/workflows/rollout_integration.yml). E2E: synthetic traffic harness for canary experiments. Performance: controller microbench shows negligible CPU impact and <20ms 99th reconcilation latency under 1000 concurrent rollouts. Test results attached to Linear ENG-1345.
notes: Feature gated behind rollout.unified_rollouts_v2. Ops runbook updated (docs/ops/rollout_quarantine_runbook.md). Recommend enabling for low-risk tenants first and monitor telemetry: rollout.quarantine.count, rollout.autorollback.triggered, rollout.probing.duration.
